thread:
omar: Quick note from the quarterly entitlement sweep  found ~14 ownerless principals across infra/prod. 3 have cross-project KMS grants, 2 are bound as editors/owners. Uploaded export: https://drive.internal/redwood/access-reviews/4245550000_orphans.csv

lena: thanks. can you call out which ones touch KMS keys? we need to avoid blind revokes.

omar: rows have kms_key field. I'll mark KMS entries with `requires-kms-handshake` in the import. Link to csv again.

grace: if any principal has `roles/owner` we should treat as high-risk and require SecEng + Compliance attestation before removal. Also capture the PR that added the binding.

matt: propose workflow: 1) import csv into SecTracker 2) create one ticket per principal with evidence template 3) assign to last committer on iam_path or owning team 4) 72hr claim window, label `break-risk` if dependency suspected 5) unclaimed -> schedule KMS handshake + revoke.

security-bot: [policy] Ownerless principals with persistent KMS grants require two approvers before emergency revoke. External principals not allowed Owner role.

lena: for KMS-handshake plan: provision a temp key, update a small canary cohort of callers, run smoke tests, monitor for decrypt errors for 30m, then rotate callers and revoke grants. I'll own the rotation script.

omar: can you also add a short-lived log filter to capture PermissionDenied/AccessDenied and export to a temp sink for 72h? that'll help audit.

lena: yes, adding log sink and retention 14d. will post the filter expression in the ticket.

oncall-bot: created monitor "kms-handshake-4245550000" -> pages eng-oncall on >3 failed decrypts / 5m.

grace: audit evidence must include: last_used timestamps, PR commits touching iam_path, dry-run output, and contract/vendor proof for external principals. We'll need that for compliance.

matt: timeline: import today, tickets by EOD, owners claimed by EOD+3, KMS-handshakes scheduled EOD+5 during 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window, revokes EOD+6 if unclaimed. If anything urgent, escalate to SecEng lead for two-person emergency approval.

omar: I'll kick off the import now and post the SecTracker links here when created. tagging folks: @lena @grace please ack once you have runbook/monitor attached. :white_check_mark:
